name: Fourier Reconstruction
definition: Reconstructs an image from the frequency spaces of projections by interpolating a polar grid into a Cartesian frequency grid, followed by an Inverse FFT.
summary: Fourier Reconstruction is an analytical tomographic method that maps projection spectra to a Cartesian frequency grid via interpolation and applies an inverse 2D Fourier transform, differing from Filtered Backprojection by performing filtering in the frequency domain.
